trust_decision.summary: Whether untrusted BOM XML may load external DTDs/entities is decided by how the JAXP factories are configured: the SchemaFactory in CycloneDxSchema.getXmlSchema(InputStream...), whose settings carry over to every Validator built from its Schema (no restriction set), and the DocumentBuilderFactory in XmlParser.createSecureDocument (only ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/SCHEMA set, no FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING).

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'BOM validation'. XmlParser.validate(Source, Version) is the validation method that builds the Validator and calls validator.validate(source). The factory that needs the fix is in the base class CycloneDxSchema.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: XmlParser.validate/isValid(File|byte[]|Reader|InputStream[, Version]) and validate(Source, Version), via getXmlSchema(Version) -> getXmlSchemaNN(); also the public CycloneDxSchema.getXmlSchema(Version) and getXmlSchema(InputStream...) used directly by downstream code
fix_sites.module_kind: base class / schema-loading helper (lower-level public API)

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: XmlParser.parse(File) and parse(byte[]) via identifySchemaVersion -> extractAllNamespaceDeclarations -> createSecureDocument
fix_sites.module_kind: parse path (namespace sniffing pre-parse), already partly hardened

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/main/java/org/cyclonedx/CycloneDxSchema.java:143 and src/main/java/org/cyclonedx/CycloneDxSchema.java:272 (public getXmlSchema(Version)/getXmlSchema(InputStream...) in the base class; the parse-path DOM builder at src/main/java/org/cyclonedx/parsers/XmlParser.java:338 is the second, 'already secure-looking' site)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can harden the Validator inside XmlParser.validate(Source, Version), which makes the report's reproduction pass, and argue that the public getXmlSchema(...) helpers are building blocks callers configure themselves. They can also dismiss createSecureDocument because ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD is already set there and it is named 'secure'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Schema compilation has to keep resolving the bom-1.x.xsd import of the SPDX namespace. That import's schemaLocation is a remote URL, and it is satisfied only because spdx.xsd is passed first in the Source array. A fix that blocks every resolution, uses a deny-all resolver, or drops or reorders the local sources breaks validation of valid BOMs. Validation must also keep returning schema errors as a List<ParseException> rather than throwing.

O7_producer.where: src/main/java/org/cyclonedx/CycloneDxSchema.java:272-279 (SchemaFactory -> Schema; the Validator inherits its security properties)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parse(InputStream)/parse(Reader) currently skip schema-version sniffing; a maintainer adding it with a buffered DOM pre-parse through its own DocumentBuilderFactory (not createSecureDocument) would create a second unhardened parser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parse(File)/parse(byte[]) already sniff the version via DOM, and making the stream overloads consistent is an obvious feature request

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached or static Schema built by a second SchemaFactory helper (e.g. a getXmlSchemaCached or a per-version factory) that bypasses getXmlSchema(InputStream...)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: building the schema on every validate call is expensive, so caching is a natural optimisation that would duplicate the factory construction

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Transformer/TransformerFactory used for pretty printing the generated Document, or a round-trip re-parse helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the generator already builds DOM documents and would plausibly serialise them through javax.xml.transform

O9_family: XXE / XML external entity (CWE-611) in JAXP schema validation

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/SCHEMA on the Validator in XmlParser.validate(Source, Version) only, leaving the public getXmlSchema(...) Schema producer and the parse-path DOM builder unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: JSON schema validation (CycloneDxSchema.java:108-114, networknt) resolves $ref through offline mappings; this is a different weakness and was not pursued.

The first listed fix commit 162aa594 is a 2020 feature commit (schema version detection, XPath namespace sniffing) against a much older tree; it does not apply to the pinned code. Only af0ec75 is the advisory fix.
unverified: Whether new XmlMapper() (src/main/java/org/cyclonedx/parsers/XmlParser.java:68, used by all parse(...) overloads) blocks external entities by default depends on jackson-dataformat-xml 2.20 / Woodstox library defaults, which are not in this repo. If it does not, parse(InputStream)/parse(Reader) at XmlParser.java:108-125 would be O8 routes.
Repo size in MB was not measured. The tiny_repo flag is inferred from a single-module Maven library whose XML handling is in 3 source files.

regression_tests_in_pinned_commit: validateShouldNotBeVulnerableToXxe is absent at the pinned commit (only BomXmlGeneratorTest.java:672 testXxeProtection exists, and the fix only tightens its message assertion), so the flag was not raised.
The JDK behaviour that a Validator inherits the SchemaFactory's ACCESS_EXTERNAL_* properties is assumed from JAXP semantics; it was not run.
